finding_retest.title: Some middle-tier tab ends still read as smooth convex fans
finding_retest.actual_change: R2 introduces clearer corners and flatter individual tabs compared with r1.
finding_retest.remaining_observation: At 180 and 225 degrees, the two main middle-tier hems on either side of the central V still sweep in long smooth convex arcs. The original A crops establish a more broken, planar plate-edge treatment. This is an edge-style observation, not a claim to know the unseen source notch positions.
finding_retest.targeted_fix: Change those long curved hems into a few visibly straight unequal plate-edge segments with crisp joins; carry the same authored topology through adjacent views. Retain the current restrained material/contour treatment.

finding_retest.title: Heavy contour and overly soft surface treatment
finding_retest.actual_change: Contours are visibly lighter/thinner and cap/fan surfaces now have clearer broad planar light changes. This resolves the concrete r1 illustration-treatment complaint; no further broad shader-style rewrite is requested.
finding_retest.remaining_limit: This does not certify the original game shader, normals or hidden surfaces.

finding_retest.title: Lower skirt is over-flared relative to the upper cap
finding_retest.observation: The native-pixel 0-degree/source comparison shows the lower skirt substantially wider relative to its cap than A61/A52. Approximate manual spans yield lower-to-cap width about 1.67 in r2 versus about 1.48 in A61. This comparison is more specific than overall width/height, which remains camera-sensitive.
finding_retest.targeted_fix: Keep upper-cap height/identity and reduce the lower flare by roughly 10-12 percent as a starting guide; adjust the middle flare only mildly to follow A61. Preserve three tiers and short trunk. Use source pixels for final judgment rather than converting the diagnostic into a game dimension.

cross_view_finding: All eight views remain plausibly one design family, with three tiers and consistent approximate scale/trunk. No conclusive impossible geometry jump is asserted. Exact common-mesh notch topology remains unverified.
limits: Do not call overall width alone a proven defect: A24 has a much steeper apparent camera than A61/A52, and source perspective changes the apparent height/width.
No conclusive impossible cross-view geometry was established. The sheet is visually plausible as one family, but its notch topology cannot be proven to arise from a single rotating 3D mesh.
Original footage does not expose every hidden surface at every azimuth. The unseen side drawings are coherent reconstruction proposals and cannot receive 100-percent source-geometry certification.
Video compression, source pixel count and different rendered presentation prevent an honest pixel-identical or exact-shader certification.
No source asset, runtime model, rig, native scene, gameplay-scale or owner-selection approval is included.
next_action: Preserve r1/r2. Make one geometric correction only: match A61 relative crown widths and flatten the remaining long convex middle hems. Keep the now-improved surface treatment and all eight views. Retest exact output bytes and all open findings.
acceptance: All mandatory checks pass and visible-source fidelity at least9.9. Full100-percent hidden-angle source identity cannot be certified from this footage.
